findings: No new finding. The finding already on the row stands and is carried into the assembly: sentence 3 of résumé B (benzecri1960_ch1.tex l.96–98) is false as printed in dimension 0 (a compact locally affine 0-manifold is finite, its universal cover a point, every subset of ℝ⁰ bounded). It now reads ResultBPrinted n ↔ 0 < n (resultBPrinted_iff): the three sentences hold together as printed exactly in dimension n ≥ 1. The affine half of sentence 1 holds as printed in every dimension, n = 0 included (resultBAffPrinted). It is non-vacuous at n = 0 on UniversalCover itself (resultB_nonVacuite_aff_dim_zero, V = ℝ⁰, which is connected).
questions: OQ-45 (a), recorded, not ruled: does sentence 3 (l.96–98) presume n ≥ 1? Reading taken: theoremB states sentences 1–2 for every n and sentence 3 under 0 < n. resultBPrinted (0 < n) is the printed form in every dimension n ≥ 1. resultBPrinted_iff records n = 0 as a counterexample. Under (a) the row is marked with no Lean change, on theoremB and resultBPrinted. Under a reading that keeps n = 0 the row stays partial.

« un convexe de l'espace affin » (l.88). Reading taken: the usual convexity of ℝⁿ, Mathlib's Convex ℝ. This equals the segment form IsAffConvex (isAffConvex_iff_convex), as in Benzecri.Chapter2.TheoremeAffine. Ch. 1 Déf. 8 defines convexity on S(E) only, and Ch. 2 Déf. 3 speaks of « le convexe φ(P) de ℝⁿ » (benzecri1960_ch2.tex l.195–196). Content-neutral.

« s'identifie à un ouvert (resp. à un convexe) de l'espace affin » (l.88). Reading taken: a compatible chart with source W maps W onto that set, as in the affine 1° (exists_chart_poche_affine) and the projective half (resultB_premiere_proj). It is also proved that the chart induces φ on P. Content-neutral.

kb_proposals: The Hopf circle ]0, ∞[ / 2^ℤ as a compact locally AFFINE 1-manifold (Applications/ResultB: resultBHopfAffGroup, resultB_nonVacuite_hopf_aff). Its generator is GXAut.ofOpens demiDroiteOuverte with (LinearEquiv.smulOfNeZero ℝ _ 2 two_ne_zero).toAffineEquiv, membership by mul_pos_iff_of_pos_left. No projOfAff is involved, so the kb/0045 instance clash does not arise. The quotient is compact (the fundamental domain [1, 2]), T2 (Mathlib instance), connected (the Quotient instance, once SimplyConnectedSpace of ]0, ∞[ is in context) and second countable. Second countability comes from ContinuousConstSMul.secondCountableTopology, a theorem, not an instance.

A connected manifold modelled on ℝ⁰ is a point (resultB_subsingleton_aff_dim_zero, the affine twin of subsingleton_dim_zero): each chart source is {x}, because the chart is injective there. So V = ℝ⁰ gives a pocket (W, φ, 0) and a strict shell on UniversalCover itself. It is the cheapest connected UniversalCover-level witness for an affine statement in dimension 0.
Proof-term walk (kb/0047): check that every watched name exists, with env.contains and a logWarning. Otherwise a misspelt or renamed name makes the walk vacuously clean.

Walking an affine row: Prop. 7′ (compact_dans_poche_affine) goes through the projective case (affToProj). So the closure of any affine Ch. 2 § 3 statement contains IsPocheProj.ligne_brisee_poche and IsPocheProj.septieme_majore. These are the ≤ forms of Prop. 6 and property 7°, true for every pocket, and they do not make the row depend on OQ-61.
notes: STATUS partial, unmarked, per the dispatch (OQ-45 (a) open). Everything in the file is proved: 0 sorry; #print axioms gives propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound on every principal declaration and both witnesses. WHAT IS NEW. (1) The affine half of sentence 1: resultB_poche_aff, for every simply connected covering π : N → V of a compact Hausdorff locally affine V with π a morphism, the twin of resultB_poche_proj; resultB_premiere_aff for UniversalCover V v₀. It gives a compatible chart φ̃ with source W and EqOn φ̃ φ P. For a shell it gives Convex ℝ φ̃.target, and for a strict shell ¬ ContainsAffLine. (2) The assembly Benzecri.theoremB, one theorem for the three sentences over UniversalCover V v₀, V : Type u, next to Benzecri.theoremA. Its four conjuncts are sentence 1 affine (every n), sentence 1 projective (every n), sentence 2 (every n) and sentence 3 (∀ n, 0 < n → …). It is the conjunction of resultB_premiere_aff, resultB_premiere_proj, resultB_deuxieme and resultB_troisieme, unchanged. (3) The printed forms over the paper's manifolds. ResultBAffPrinted n, the affine half, holds for every n (resultBAffPrinted). ResultBPrinted n := ResultBAffPrinted n ∧ ResultBProjPrinted n ∧ ResultBTroisiemePrinted n, reusing the strict defs of TheoremB. resultBPrinted : 0 < n → ResultBPrinted n, and resultBPrinted_iff : ResultBPrinted n ↔ 0 < n. THE PROOF-TERM WALK (kb/0047; /tmp/resultB-walk/Walk.lean, a copy, nothing written in the package). Roots: every principal declaration and both witnesses, 11 in all. The walk is a transitive closure of Expr.getUsedConstants over types and values, with allowOpaque. 42 watched names were checked, every one present in the environment. They are the 8 the block names (poche_eq_connectedComponentIn_affine, poche_eq_preimage_iff_affine, premierAffinePrinted_iff, PremierAffinePrinted, ConnexeAffinePrinted, theoreme_premier_affine, TheoremeAffinePrinted, theoremeAffinePrinted_iff). They also include every other affine 1°c name: closure_inter_preimage_subset_poche_affine, poche_eq_preimage_of_{starConvex,convex,cote_eq_zero,coque}_affine, isPreconnected_inter_range_of_coque_affine, isCoqueAff_iff_convex_range_affine, isCoqueStricteAff_iff_range_affine, theoreme_poche_balayable_affine, the Composante/Literal printed forms, situation_exemple_affine, exemple_poche_affine_of_poche, premier/connexeAffinePrinted_of_le_one. Finally they include the projective 1°c names of the earlier walk (OQ-71). RESULT: CLEAN. No root reaches any watched name, and no Benzecri name in the union closure contains Connexe, poche_eq, cote_eq_zero, PremierAffine, theoreme_premier, theoreme_poche or TheoremeAffine. The affine half uses 1°a–1°b (exists_chart_poche_affine, through PremierGX.exists_chart_eqOn, injective_of_isDeveloping_of_poche_affine and Prop. 7′ deux_points_dans_poche_affine / compact_dans_poche_affine), 3° (theoreme_troisieme_affine) and 4° (theoreme_quatrieme_affine, through containsAffLine_range_iff_affine). So OQ-75 and OQ-79 do not reach the row: bzthm:intro_B is closed up to OQ-45 (a) alone, and at graduation its blocked_on can be re-pointed at OQ-45 (a). INCIDENTAL REACH, all proved lemmas, none of them a 1°c name. (a) IsPocheProj.ligne_brisee_poche and septieme_majore, the ≤ forms true for every pocket (OQ-61 (b)'s statements), are reached from the affine half too, through Prop. 7′ → affToProj. The strict OQ-61 (a) forms are not reached (septieme_propriete_of_ne_zero, ligne_brisee_poche_of_ne_zero). (b) pseudoLength_self (stated under 1 ≤ n) and ouvert_plein (stated under 0 < r) are reached only through the projective half (theoremB, resultBPrinted, resultBPrinted_iff), as the T-bz-result-b-proj walk found. They are proved lemmas with their hypotheses discharged, so they do not make the row wait on OQ-45 or OQ-62. NON-VACUITY. (1) resultB_nonVacuite_hopf_aff, n = 1, non-degenerate. The Hopf circle V = ]0, ∞[ / 2^ℤ, with x ↦ 2x affine, is a compact, Hausdorff, connected, second countable, locally affine manifold. π : ]0, ∞[ → V is a simply connected covering and an affine morphism. The strict shell P = ]0, 1[ ≠ ]0, ∞[ has the non-constant cote x₀ (exists_isCoqueStricteAff_demiDroite_ne_univ, the post-merge name). resultB_poche_aff then gives the chart, with convex target and no line, and sentence 3 holds as well (the projection is unbounded). This is the general-covering form (kb/0043). (2) resultB_nonVacuite_aff_dim_zero, on UniversalCover V v₀ itself, with V = ℝ⁰ (connected, unlike the projective S(0) witness). The strict shell (W, φ, 0) is degenerate: P = W and the cote is constant. It sits in the dimension where sentence 3 fails. BUILD. `lake env lean` and `lake env lean -DwarningAsError=true` give no warning and no error. `lake build BenzecriScaffold.Applications.ResultB` was run twice. The first run came after the main proofs. The second came at the very end, because resultB_subsingleton_aff_dim_zero and resultB_nonVacuite_aff_dim_zero were added after the first run. Both succeeded in about 3.5 s, nothing upstream rebuilt, and pgrep showed no other lake build either time. GRADUATION. The module imports Benzecri.Applications.TheoremB and Benzecri.Chapter2.TheoremeAffine. It is not added to scaffold/BenzecriScaffold.lean or Benzecri.lean. Names are new and checked free by grep: theoremB, resultB_*_aff, ResultB(Aff)Printed, resultBHopfAff*, resultB_hopfAff_*. Only docstring lines (title, checklist rows) exceed 100 characters, as in TheoremB.lean. Every instance in the Hopf witness is local (haveI), so graduation adds no global instance. The row's curated decls would gain the ten listed under decls; the Hopf helpers are in extra_decls. Under an OQ-45 (a) ruling the marking anchors are theoremB and resultBPrinted, with no Lean change; the docstring line 11 would then become **`bzthm:intro_B`**.
